sv.title: Trycket stiger i Tyskland
sv.summary: Tysklands tyngsta barometer steg i november till den högsta nivån sedan våren 2023. Uppgången rimmar väl med måndagens starka signaler. Europas största ekonomi ökar takten.

en.title: Pressure rises in Germany
en.summary: Germany's most important barometer rose in November to its highest level since spring 2023. The rise fits well with Monday's strong signals. Europe's largest economy is picking up pace.
